MERGE INTO dbo.Products AS target
USING Staging.Products AS source
ON target.id = source.id  -- Match condition based on unique identifier
WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET 
        target.title = source.title,
        target.price = source.price,
        target.category = source.category,
        target.description = source.description,
        target.image = source.image  -- Update existing record
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT (id, title, price, category, description, image)
    VALUES (source.id, source.title, source.price, source.category, source.description, source.image);  -- Insert new record
	select 1

MERGE INTO dbo.Orders AS target
USING (SELECT DISTINCT id, userId, date FROM Staging.Orders) AS source
ON target.id = source.id
WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET 
        target.userId = source.userId,
        target.date = source.date  -- Overwrite existing order details if they match by ID
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT (id, userId, date)
    VALUES (source.id, source.userId, source.date);  -- Insert new orders if they don't exist

MERGE INTO dbo.OrderProducts AS target
USING Staging.Orders AS source
ON target.orderId = source.id AND target.productId = source.productId  -- Match on order ID and product ID
WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET 
        target.quantity = source.quantity  -- Overwrite existing product quantity if it matches by orderId and productId
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT (orderId, productId, quantity)
    VALUES (source.id, source.productId, source.quantity);  -- Insert new product details if they don't exist
	select 1

MERGE INTO dbo.Users AS target
USING (
    SELECT 
        id, email, username, password, firstname AS first_name, lastname AS last_name, phone
    FROM 
        Staging.Users
) AS source
ON target.id = source.id
WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET 
        target.email = source.email,
        target.username = source.username,
        target.password = source.password,
        target.first_name = source.first_name,
        target.last_name = source.last_name,
        target.phone = source.phone  -- Overwrite existing user data if matched by ID
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT (id, email, username, password, first_name, last_name, phone)
    VALUES (source.id, source.email, source.username, source.password, source.first_name, source.last_name, source.phone);  -- Insert new user if not exists

MERGE INTO dbo.Addresses AS target
USING (
    SELECT 
        id AS user_id, city, street, 
        CAST(number AS INT) AS number, 
        zipcode, lat AS geolocation_lat, long AS geolocation_long
    FROM 
        Staging.Users
) AS source
ON target.user_id = source.user_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN
    UPDATE SET 
        target.city = source.city,
        target.street = source.street,
        target.number = source.number,
        target.zipcode = source.zipcode,
        target.geolocation_lat = source.geolocation_lat,
        target.geolocation_long = source.geolocation_long  -- Update address details if a match by user_id exists
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
    INSERT (user_id, city, street, number, zipcode, geolocation_lat, geolocation_long)
    VALUES (source.user_id, source.city, source.street, source.number, source.zipcode, source.geolocation_lat, source.geolocation_long);  -- Insert address if not exists
	select 1
